bar_graph_prompts.name: long_labels_abbreviation
bar_graph_prompts.description: Very long category names that cause overlapping labels unless abbreviated or rotated.
bar_graph_prompts.prompt:
Create a bar chart for the following categories and values. Ensure all category names remain readable. If they overlap, shorten or abbreviate appropriately.

• Superconducting_Material_Prototype_Version_Alpha → 14
• Quantum_Resistant_Encryption_Module_Experimental → 9
• Hybrid_NanoFabrication_Control_Subsystem → 22
• Uncalibrated_Doppler_Spectroscopy_Array_Testing → 5

Make the final visualization clean and readable.

bar_graph_prompts.name: extreme_range_scaling
bar_graph_prompts.description: One bar is much larger than others, hiding small values. Requires rescaling or annotation.
bar_graph_prompts.prompt:
Plot a bar chart for:
• A → 1
• B → 3
• C → 2
• D → 5000
• E → 4

Adjust formatting so that the small bars remain visually interpretable. You may rescale, annotate, or change the bar styles—whatever makes all values clearly visible.

bar_graph_prompts.name: manual_grouped_bars
bar_graph_prompts.description: Two data series must be grouped manually without grouped-bar tools. Requires spacing correction.
bar_graph_prompts.prompt:
I need a bar chart of monthly revenue for two product lines plotted in a single axis without grouped-bar tools:

Months = Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr
Product X = 4, 8, 9, 3
Product Y = 5, 2, 7, 6

Place bars side-by-side manually for each month. Ensure spacing is correct and the month labels do not collide. Fix the chart until it looks like a proper grouped bar chart.

bar_graph_prompts.name: color_encoding_validation
bar_graph_prompts.description: Color must encode statistical meaning; the model must verify visually that color mapping matches the data.
bar_graph_prompts.prompt:
Create a bar chart with the following values:

K → 40
L → 10
M → 25
N → 35

Apply this color rule:
- Highest value must be bright red
- Lowest value must be deep blue
- All others must be gray

Refine the plot until colors accurately reflect the ordering.

bar_graph_prompts.name: dense_categories_crowding
bar_graph_prompts.description: 30 closely spaced categories create unreadable crowding unless spacing, rotation, or resizing is applied.
bar_graph_prompts.prompt:
Make a bar chart for values of 30 micro-categories:
Category01 = 3, Category02 = 1, … Category30 = 5

Ensure all labels remain readable and the figure is not visually overcrowded. You may enlarge the figure, rotate labels, or adjust spacing as needed.
